definitions.explanation: First-person pronoun used in formal situations.

examples.japanese: {私|わたくし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{申|もう}します→申す：01319_mousu⟧。
{私|わたくし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べます→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
{私|わたくし}⟦ども→ども：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{私|わたくし}⟦{事|ごと}→事：noentry⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{恐縮|きょうしゅく}→恐縮：07596_kyoushuku⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧。
examples.english: I'm sorry to bring up a personal matter, but...

examples.japanese: {私|わたくし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to value my private time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公|おおやけ}→公：11991_ooyake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{私|わたくし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{控|ひか}えるべき→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧⟦だ→だ：noentry⟧。
examples.english: One should refrain from talking about private matters in public settings.

notes:
{私|わたくし} is the most formal first-person pronoun in Japanese, used in business settings, formal speeches, and very polite situations.

FORMALITY COMPARISON:
- {私|わたくし}: very formal (business, ceremonies)
- ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧: polite/neutral (general use)
- ⟦{僕|ぼく}→僕：01729_boku⟧: casual male speech
- ⟦{俺|おれ}→俺：02185_ore⟧: very casual male speech
- ⟦あたし→あたし：noentry⟧: casual female speech

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {私|わたくし}⟦ども→ども：noentry⟧: we (humble, business)
- {私|わたくし}⟦め→〜め：noentry⟧: I (very humble, archaic)
- {私|わたくし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧: my opinion (formal)

SENSE 2 - PRIVATE:
As a noun meaning "private matters":
- {私|わたくし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: private/personal time
- {私|わたくし}⟦{事|ごと}→事：noentry⟧: private matter
- ⟦{公私|こうし}→公私：21213_koushi⟧: public and private

USAGE:
- Job interviews and business meetings
- Formal speeches and presentations
- Customer service and hospitality
- Letters and formal writing
